title: Design exercise: SAA-4.1-S02
scenario: Bellhaven Dairy Co-op is moving its ERP database to a single new server with one block volume. The database holds 1.1 TB today and has grown by about 40 GB a month for three years. The old server carried a 4 TB volume 'to be safe', and Finance now refuses to pay for capacity that will not hold data within the next 90 days. The database may be stopped only during a quarterly maintenance window, and the volume type and performance settings stay as they are.
constraints: Do not claim live AWS experience
Finance pays only for capacity needed within the next 90 days
The database cannot be stopped outside the quarterly maintenance window
The data-platform engineer reviews capacity once a month and has no time to rebuild servers

rubric.label: The initial volume is between 1.22 TB (today's 1.1 TB plus 90 days at 40 GB a month) and 1.5 TB, with any rounding or margin stated
Making the volume larger later needs no database stop and no new server, and the record gives the monthly check that triggers it

constraint_reason: Mapped as design_exercise to complete skill coverage when no dedicated live lab step exists
